newsitem.title: USA: Pa. 850 MW Conemaugh 1 coal unit seen back today.
newsitem.headline: Pa. 850 MW Conemaugh 1 coal unit seen back today.

text.p: A 850 megawatt (MW) unit at the Conemaugh coal-fired generating complex was expected to resume operation later today after being shut last Friday to repair a boiler tube leak, the operator said Thursday.
"It'll be around noon (1200 EST)," said a GPU Generation Inc spokeswoman when asked about a startup time for Conemaugh's unit 1.
The nearby Conemaugh unit 2 was running at 100 percent of its 850 MW capacity, she added.
The Conemaugh units in western Pennsylvania's Indiana County is jointly owned by utility members of the Pennsylvania-New Jersey-Maryland Interconnect power pool.
GPU Generation is a subsidiary of GPU Inc of Parsippany, N.J.
